Paragraph: "Seeing such tranquil beauty makes my agitated mind feel even more restless, for peace eludes me..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Contrast between calm external water and restless internal thoughts.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama notes his inability to reach internal peace despite serene surroundings.
Outcome/Resolution: He admits his ongoing struggle with inner agitation.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Anxiety: Restlessness, Agitation, Inability to Attain Calm

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Chitta-Vikshepa (Agitation and restlessness of the mind obstructing peace)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Highlights the difficulty of attaining mental quietude (Shanti) when emotional attachments remain severed or threatened.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Agitation and restlessness: experiencing cognitive friction when internal distress resists external soothing.
